page.layout: One printed page: title page, centred text in several lines, a woodcut vignette in the middle, the imprint below. No margin notes. The digitiser's footer bar is not transcribed.

main_text.l: TATIS, quicquid est Rerum memorabilium, Rituumq;
Romanorum, in Comicorum Latinorum Principe M. ACCIO

page.notes: The woodcut vignette (an oval cartouche with the motto "BATAVIAM ... INVENIENT" and a sea scene with a figure) has no text to transcribe apart from that motto, which is only partly legible on the scan. Spellings such as "Vniversales", "Rituumq;" and "Bibliopolæ" are as printed; "Bibliopolæ" is uncertain and may read differently. The imprint line "Impensis IONÆ ROSÆ" is set with swash capitals and is copied as best read.
